input.summary: Hit the captive balls to qualify Stewie Pinball, then use the mini-playfield to complete the family and start Stewie Multiball. During Stewie Multiball, prioritize the difficult mini-playfield members while the main-playfield ball save protects the stack.
checkBeforePlay: Confirm this is factory Family Guy, not Shrek.
Confirm both Newton captive balls are present and working.

steps.text: Hit either captive Newton ball to spell P-I-N-B-A-L-L. Use controlled shots rather than repeated live-ball impacts.
When P-I-N-B-A-L-L is complete, shoot the TV scoop to start Stewie Pinball on the mini-playfield.
On Stewie Pinball, complete Brian, Meg, Peter, Lois, and Chris with the mini ramps, loops, and targets.
modeNotes: Completing all five family members starts Stewie Multiball. The mini-playfield does not award ordinary points outside its named objectives.

steps.text: During Stewie Multiball, use the opening ball save to finish the harder Peter and Meg mini-playfield shots before protecting every main-playfield ball.
modeNotes: The family shots on both playfields qualify the Stewie Super Jackpot. Main-playfield Stewie targets can add mini-playfield time.

steps.text: Hit captive balls during Stewie Multiball to respell P-I-N-B-A-L-L and add a ball when fewer than four are active.
When the mini timer expires, return attention to the main playfield and finish the lit family shots for the Super Jackpot.

fallback.title: Fart Multiball and TV modes
fallback.when: Use this when the captive-ball rebounds or mini-playfield are unreliable.

steps.text: Clear the F-A-R-T four-bank to advance Fart Multiball.
Shoot the spinner target or right orbit to light the TV scoop.
Start a TV mode at the scoop before multiball when stacking is allowed.
If Crazy Chris is progressing, start Fart Multiball as protection. Crazy Chris continues during Fart, which also offers an add-a-ball.
Use Death's raised post as a temporary center save when it is available.
Spell P-I-N-B-A-L-L at the captive balls.
Start Stewie Pinball at the TV scoop.
Complete all five family members to start Stewie Multiball.
Complete the lit family shots on both playfields for the Super Jackpot.

strategy.summary: Spell P-I-N-B-A-L-L at the captive balls, start Donkey Pinball at the Swamp scoop, and complete all five mini-playfield characters to begin Donkey Multiball. During multiball, pair each character's mini-playfield shot with its main-playfield shot, then collect the Super Jackpot at the Castle Guard lane.
checkBeforePlay: Test both captive balls, the Swamp scoop eject, and the Donkey mini-playfield flippers.
Check whether tournament settings change Extra Ball, Special, or multiball behavior.

steps.text: Hit either captive ball to spell P-I-N-B-A-L-L. Use controlled shots because both captive-ball rebounds can leave the center exposed.
When P-I-N-B-A-L-L is lit, shoot the Swamp scoop to start Donkey Pinball on the mini-playfield.
On Donkey Pinball, complete Fiona, Gingy, Shrek, Puss, and Charm with the two orbits, standups, and ramp.
modeNotes: Completing all five characters starts Donkey Multiball. Character completions also raise the playfield multiplier during Donkey Pinball.

steps.text: During Donkey Multiball, complete each character once on the mini-playfield and once on the main playfield. Use the opening ball save for the harder mini-playfield shots.
modeNotes: Hit either Donkey target when the mini timer expires to relaunch the mini ball.

steps.text: After all character pairs are complete, shoot the Castle Guard Jackpot lane for the Super Jackpot.
During Donkey Multiball, respell P-I-N-B-A-L-L at the lit captive balls to add a ball.

fallback.title: Baby Multiball and a Swamp mode
fallback.when: Use this when the captive-ball rebounds or Donkey mini-playfield are unreliable.

steps.text: Complete the B-A-B-Y drop bank twice, then knock down three targets in the third bank.
Spin the Gingy spinner to light the Swamp scoop.
Start the selected Swamp mode at the scoop, then hit the last standing B-A-B-Y target to start two-ball Baby Multiball.

Keep both balls moving through the ramp, orbits, spinner, targets, and rollovers. The first 10 registered switches score a Baby Multiball Jackpot; later Jackpots require 12, 14, 16, 18, then 20 switches.
Spell P-I-N-B-A-L-L at the captive balls.
Start Donkey Pinball at the Swamp scoop.
Complete all five mini-playfield characters to start Donkey Multiball.
Complete each character on both playfields, then shoot the Castle Guard lane for the Super Jackpot.

cautions.issue: The captive balls can reject toward the center.
cautions.response: Shoot them from a controlled cradle and stop forcing the spellout after an unsafe rebound.

cautions.issue: Donkey Pinball pulls attention away from live balls on the main playfield during multiball.
cautions.response: Use the opening ball save for mini-playfield progress, then return attention to the main playfield before protection ends.

Spell P-I-N-B-A-L-L at the captive balls, start the mini-game at the Swamp scoop, complete Fiona, Gingy, Shrek, Puss, and Charm, then finish each character on both playfields for the Castle Guard Super Jackpot.
